title: Along each ray, the orientation of an integer multiplicity 1-triple carried by finitely many rays is ±e (parent step 4)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let R = (M, θ, ξ) be a 1-dimensional integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ 1: carrier M, multiplicity θ, orientation ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_1(ℝ^P)), and let F be a finite set of unit vectors with H¹(M ∖ ⋃_{e∈F} ray(e)) = 0, where H¹ = μHE[1] and ray(e) := {te : t > 0}. Then for every e ∈ F and H¹-almost every x ∈ M ∩ ray(e), either ξ(x) = ev_e or ξ(x) = −ev_e, where ev_e ∈ Λ_1(ℝ^P) is the 1-vector α ↦ α(e) (ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply at the family fun _ : Fin 1 => e).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)) (R.carrier ∩ (⋃ e ∈ F, (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)ᶜ) = 0 → ∀ e ∈ F, ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict (R.carrier ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)), R.orient x = ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e) ∨ R.orient x = -ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e)
